title_en: I didn’t … / Did you … ? (past simple negative and questions)
title_vi: I didn’t … / Did you … ? (phủ định và câu hỏi thì quá khứ đơn)
theory_html:
A. did in past simple negatives and questions

A. did trong câu phủ định và câu hỏi quá khứ đơn

We use did in past simple negatives and questions:

Dùng did trong câu phủ định và câu hỏi thì quá khứ đơn:

infinitive
nguyên mẫu		positive
khẳng định		negative
phủ định		question
câu hỏi
play / start / watchplayed / started / watchedI / we / you / they / he / she / it did not (didn’t) play / start / watchdid I / we / you / they / he / she / it play? / start? / watch?
have / see / do / gohad / saw / did / went… didn’t have / see / do / godid … have? / see? / do? / go?

do / does (present) → did (past):

do / does (hiện tại) → did (quá khứ):

  • I don’t watch TV very often. → I didn’t watch TV yesterday.

    Tôi không hay xem TV. → Hôm qua tôi không xem TV.

  • Does she often go away? → Did she go away last week?

    Cô ấy có hay đi xa không? → Tuần trước cô ấy có đi xa không?

B. did / didn’t + infinitive

B. did / didn’t + động từ nguyên mẫu

We use did / didn’t + infinitive (watch / play / go etc.):

Dùng did / didn’t + động từ nguyên mẫu (watch / play / go v.v.):

positive
khẳng định		negative / question
phủ định / câu hỏi
I watchedI didn’t watch (not I didn’t watched)
they wentdid they go? (not did they went?)
he hadhe didn’t have
you diddid you do?

  • I played tennis yesterday, but I didn’t win.

    Hôm qua tôi chơi quần vợt, nhưng tôi không thắng.

  • ‘Did you do the shopping?’ ‘No, I didn’t have time.’

    ‘Bạn đã đi mua sắm chưa?’ ‘Chưa, tôi không có thời gian.’

  • We went to the cinema, but we didn’t enjoy the film.

    Chúng tôi đi xem phim, nhưng không thích bộ phim.

C. Study the word order in questions

C. Trật tự từ trong câu hỏi

(question word)
(từ để hỏi)		didsubject
chủ ngữ		infinitive
nguyên mẫu
Didyour sistercall you?
Whatdidyoudo last night?
Howdidthe accidenthappen?
Wheredidyour parentsgo for their holiday?

D. Short answers

D. Câu trả lời ngắn

Yes, …No, …
Yes, I / we / you / they / he / she / it did.No, I / we / you / they / he / she / it didn’t.

  • ‘Did you see Joe yesterday?’ ‘No, I didn’t.’

    ‘Hôm qua bạn có gặp Joe không?’ ‘Không.’

  • ‘Did it rain on Sunday?’ ‘Yes, it did.’

    ‘Chủ nhật trời có mưa không?’ ‘Có.’

  • ‘Did Helen come to the party?’ ‘No, she didn’t.’

    ‘Helen có đến bữa tiệc không?’ ‘Không.’

  • ‘Did your parents have a good holiday?’ ‘Yes, they did.’

    ‘Bố mẹ bạn có kỳ nghỉ vui không?’ ‘Có.’

mcq.question: I don’t watch TV very often. I ___ TV yesterday.
mcq.full: I don’t watch TV very often. I didn’t watch TV yesterday.
mcq.vi: Tôi không hay xem TV. Hôm qua tôi không xem TV.
mcq.expl:
Past simple negative/questions use did: didn’t + verb; did + subject + verb?
Phủ định/câu hỏi quá khứ đơn dùng did: didn’t + động từ; did + chủ ngữ + động từ?
Điểm ngữ pháp: "yesterday" → didn’t + nguyên mẫu.
mcq.key: I don’t watch TV very often. I ___ TV yesterday.|didn’t watch

mcq.question: Does she often go away? ___ go away last week?
mcq.full: Does she often go away? Did she go away last week?
mcq.vi: Cô ấy có hay đi xa không? Tuần trước cô ấy có đi xa không?
mcq.expl:
Past simple negative/questions use did: didn’t + verb; did + subject + verb?
Phủ định/câu hỏi quá khứ đơn dùng did: didn’t + động từ; did + chủ ngữ + động từ?
Điểm ngữ pháp: "last week" → Did.
mcq.key: Does she often go away? ___ go away last week?|Did she

mcq.question: I saw Barbara, but I ___ Jane.
mcq.full: I saw Barbara, but I didn’t see Jane.
mcq.vi: Tôi gặp Barbara, nhưng tôi không gặp Jane.
mcq.expl:
Past simple negative/questions use did: didn’t + verb; did + subject + verb?
Phủ định/câu hỏi quá khứ đơn dùng did: didn’t + động từ; did + chủ ngữ + động từ?
Điểm ngữ pháp: didn’t + see.
mcq.key: I saw Barbara, but I ___ Jane.|didn’t see

mcq.question: They worked on Monday, but they ___ on Tuesday.
mcq.full: They worked on Monday, but they didn’t work on Tuesday.
mcq.vi: Họ làm việc hôm thứ Hai, nhưng không làm hôm thứ Ba.
mcq.expl:
Past simple negative/questions use did: didn’t + verb; did + subject + verb?
Phủ định/câu hỏi quá khứ đơn dùng did: didn’t + động từ; did + chủ ngữ + động từ?
Điểm ngữ pháp: didn’t + work.
mcq.key: They worked on Monday, but they ___ on Tuesday.|didn’t work

mcq.question: We went to the post office, but we ___ to the bank.
mcq.full: We went to the post office, but we didn’t go to the bank.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi đến bưu điện, nhưng không đến ngân hàng.
mcq.expl:
Past simple negative/questions use did: didn’t + verb; did + subject + verb?
Phủ định/câu hỏi quá khứ đơn dùng did: didn’t + động từ; did + chủ ngữ + động từ?
Điểm ngữ pháp: didn’t + go.
mcq.key: We went to the post office, but we ___ to the bank.|didn’t go

mcq.question: She had a pen, but she ___ any paper.
mcq.full: She had a pen, but she didn’t have any paper.
mcq.vi: Cô ấy có bút, nhưng không có giấy.
mcq.expl:
Past simple negative/questions use did: didn’t + verb; did + subject + verb?
Phủ định/câu hỏi quá khứ đơn dùng did: didn’t + động từ; did + chủ ngữ + động từ?
Điểm ngữ pháp: didn’t + have.
mcq.key: She had a pen, but she ___ any paper.|didn’t have

mcq.question: Jack did French at school, but he ___ German.
mcq.full: Jack did French at school, but he didn’t do German.
mcq.vi: Jack học tiếng Pháp ở trường, nhưng không học tiếng Đức.
mcq.expl:
Past simple negative/questions use did: didn’t + verb; did + subject + verb?
Phủ định/câu hỏi quá khứ đơn dùng did: didn’t + động từ; did + chủ ngữ + động từ?
Điểm ngữ pháp: didn’t + do (động từ chính).
mcq.key: Jack did French at school, but he ___ German.|didn’t do

mcq.question: I played tennis yesterday, but I ___.
mcq.full: I played tennis yesterday, but I didn’t win.
mcq.vi: Hôm qua tôi chơi quần vợt, nhưng tôi không thắng.
mcq.expl:
After did/didn’t use the infinitive: I didn’t watch (not didn’t watched), did they go? (not did they went?).
Sau did/didn’t dùng nguyên mẫu: I didn’t watch (không phải didn’t watched), did they go? (không phải did they went?).
Điểm ngữ pháp: didn’t + win.
mcq.key: I played tennis yesterday, but I ___.|didn’t win

mcq.question: ‘Did you do the shopping?’ ‘No, I ___ time.’
mcq.full: ‘Did you do the shopping?’ ‘No, I didn’t have time.’
mcq.vi: ‘Bạn đã đi mua sắm chưa?’ ‘Chưa, tôi không có thời gian.’
mcq.expl:
After did/didn’t use the infinitive: I didn’t watch (not didn’t watched), did they go? (not did they went?).
Sau did/didn’t dùng nguyên mẫu: I didn’t watch (không phải didn’t watched), did they go? (không phải did they went?).
Điểm ngữ pháp: didn’t + have.
mcq.key: ‘Did you do the shopping?’ ‘No, I ___ time.’|didn’t have

mcq.question: We went to the cinema, but we ___ the film.
mcq.full: We went to the cinema, but we didn’t enjoy the film.

After did/didn’t use the infinitive: I didn’t watch (not didn’t watched), did they go? (not did they went?).
Sau did/didn’t dùng nguyên mẫu: I didn’t watch (không phải didn’t watched), did they go? (không phải did they went?).
Điểm ngữ pháp: didn’t + enjoy.
mcq.key: We went to the cinema, but we ___ the film.|didn’t enjoy

mcq.question: ‘___ the shopping?’ ‘No, I didn’t have time.’
mcq.full: ‘Did you do the shopping?’ ‘No, I didn’t have time.’
mcq.vi: ‘Bạn đã đi mua sắm chưa?’ ‘Chưa, tôi không có thời gian.’
mcq.expl:
After did/didn’t use the infinitive: I didn’t watch (not didn’t watched), did they go? (not did they went?).

Điểm ngữ pháp: Did + you + do.
mcq.key: ‘___ the shopping?’ ‘No, I didn’t have time.’|Did you do

mcq.question: I watched TV last night. How about you? ___ TV last night?
mcq.full: I watched TV last night. How about you? Did you watch TV last night?
mcq.vi: Tối qua tôi xem TV. Còn bạn? Bạn có xem TV tối qua không?
mcq.expl:
After did/didn’t use the infinitive: I didn’t watch (not didn’t watched), did they go? (not did they went?).
Sau did/didn’t dùng nguyên mẫu: I didn’t watch (không phải didn’t watched), did they go? (không phải did they went?).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Did + you + watch.
mcq.key: I watched TV last night. How about you? ___ TV last night?|Did you watch

mcq.question: I enjoyed the party. How about you? ___ the party?
mcq.full: I enjoyed the party. How about you? Did you enjoy the party?

mcq.expl:
After did/didn’t use the infinitive: I didn’t watch (not didn’t watched), did they go? (not did they went?).
Sau did/didn’t dùng nguyên mẫu: I didn’t watch (không phải didn’t watched), did they go? (không phải did they went?).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Did + you + enjoy.
mcq.key: I enjoyed the party. How about you? ___ the party?|Did you enjoy

mcq.question: I slept well last night. How about you? ___ well last night?
mcq.full: I slept well last night. How about you? Did you sleep well last night?
mcq.vi: Tối qua tôi ngủ ngon. Còn bạn? Bạn có ngủ ngon không?
mcq.expl:
After did/didn’t use the infinitive: I didn’t watch (not didn’t watched), did they go? (not did they went?).
Sau did/didn’t dùng nguyên mẫu: I didn’t watch (không phải didn’t watched), did they go? (không phải did they went?).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Did + you + sleep.
mcq.key: I slept well last night. How about you? ___ well last night?|Did you sleep

mcq.question: ___ call you?
mcq.full: Did your sister call you?
mcq.vi: Chị bạn có gọi cho bạn không?
mcq.expl:
Word order: (question word) + did + subject + infinitive.
Trật tự: (từ để hỏi) + did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu.
mcq.key: ___ call you?|Did your sister

mcq.question: What ___ last night?

mcq.vi: Tối qua bạn đã làm gì?
mcq.expl:
Word order: (question word) + did + subject + infinitive.
Trật tự: (từ để hỏi) + did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: What + did + you + do?
mcq.key: What ___ last night?|did you do

mcq.question: How ___ happen?

mcq.expl:
Word order: (question word) + did + subject + infinitive.
Trật tự: (từ để hỏi) + did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: How + did + the accident + happen?
mcq.key: How ___ happen?|did the accident

mcq.question: Where ___ for their holiday?
mcq.full: Where did your parents go for their holiday?

mcq.expl:
Word order: (question word) + did + subject + infinitive.
Trật tự: (từ để hỏi) + did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Where + did + chủ ngữ + go.
mcq.key: Where ___ for their holiday?|did your parents go

mcq.question: A: We went to New York last month. B: Where ___?
mcq.full: A: We went to New York last month. B: Where did you stay?
mcq.vi: A: Tháng trước chúng tôi đi New York. B: Các bạn đã ở đâu?
mcq.expl:
Word order: (question word) + did + subject + infinitive.
Trật tự: (từ để hỏi) + did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Where + did + you + stay?

mcq.question: A: I was late for the meeting. B: What time ___?

Trật tự: (từ để hỏi) + did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: What time + did + you + arrive?
mcq.key: A: I was late for the meeting. B: What time ___?|did you arrive

mcq.question: A: I played tennis this afternoon. B: ___? A: No, I lost.
mcq.full: A: I played tennis this afternoon. B: Did you win? A: No, I lost.
mcq.vi: A: Chiều nay tôi chơi quần vợt. B: Bạn có thắng không? A: Không, tôi thua.
mcq.expl:
Word order: (question word) + did + subject + infinitive.
Trật tự: (từ để hỏi) + did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Did + you + win.
mcq.key: A: I played tennis this afternoon. B: ___? A: No, I lost.|Did you win

mcq.question: A: We came home by taxi. B: How much ___?
mcq.full: A: We came home by taxi. B: How much did it cost?
mcq.vi: A: Chúng tôi về nhà bằng taxi. B: Hết bao nhiêu tiền?
mcq.expl:
Word order: (question word) + did + subject + infinitive.
Trật tự: (từ để hỏi) + did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: How much + did + it + cost?
mcq.key: A: We came home by taxi. B: How much ___?|did it cost

mcq.question: A: The window is broken. B: How ___?
mcq.full: A: The window is broken. B: How did it happen?
mcq.vi: A: Cửa sổ bị vỡ. B: Chuyện đã xảy ra thế nào?
mcq.expl:
Word order: (question word) + did + subject + infinitive.
Trật tự: (từ để hỏi) + did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: How + did + it + happen?
mcq.key: A: The window is broken. B: How ___?|did it happen

mcq.question: ‘I cut my hand this morning.’ ‘How ___ that?’
mcq.full: ‘I cut my hand this morning.’ ‘How did you do that?’
mcq.vi: ‘Sáng nay tôi bị đứt tay.’ ‘Sao bạn lại bị thế?’
mcq.expl:
Word order: (question word) + did + subject + infinitive.
Trật tự: (từ để hỏi) + did + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu.
Điểm ngữ pháp: How + did + you + do?
mcq.key: ‘I cut my hand this morning.’ ‘How ___ that?’|did you do

mcq.question: ‘Did you see Joe yesterday?’ ‘No, ___.’
mcq.full: ‘Did you see Joe yesterday?’ ‘No, I didn’t.’
mcq.vi: ‘Hôm qua bạn có gặp Joe không?’ ‘Không.’
mcq.expl:
Short answers: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
Trả lời ngắn: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
Điểm ngữ pháp: No, I didn’t.
mcq.key: ‘Did you see Joe yesterday?’ ‘No, ___.’|I didn’t

mcq.question: ‘Did it rain on Sunday?’ ‘Yes, ___.’
mcq.full: ‘Did it rain on Sunday?’ ‘Yes, it did.’
mcq.vi: ‘Chủ nhật trời có mưa không?’ ‘Có.’
mcq.expl:
Short answers: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
Trả lời ngắn: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Yes, it did.
mcq.key: ‘Did it rain on Sunday?’ ‘Yes, ___.’|it did

mcq.question: ‘Did Helen come to the party?’ ‘No, ___.’

mcq.expl:
Short answers: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
Trả lời ngắn: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
Điểm ngữ pháp: No, she didn’t.

mcq.question: ‘Did your parents have a good holiday?’ ‘Yes, ___.’

mcq.vi: ‘Bố mẹ bạn có kỳ nghỉ vui không?’ ‘Có.’
mcq.expl:
Short answers: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
Trả lời ngắn: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Yes, they did.
mcq.key: ‘Did your parents have a good holiday?’ ‘Yes, ___.’|they did

mcq.question: Tom ___ some new clothes yesterday – two shirts, a jacket and a pullover.
mcq.full: Tom bought some new clothes yesterday – two shirts, a jacket and a pullover.
mcq.vi: Hôm qua Tom đã mua mấy bộ quần áo mới – hai áo sơ mi, một áo khoác và một áo len.
mcq.expl:
Positive, negative or question depends on the meaning.
Khẳng định, phủ định hay câu hỏi tùy theo nghĩa.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Nghĩa khẳng định → bought.
mcq.key: Tom ___ some new clothes yesterday – two shirts, a jacket and a pullover.|bought

mcq.question: ‘___ yesterday?’ ‘No, it was a nice day.’
mcq.full: ‘Did it rain yesterday?’ ‘No, it was a nice day.’
mcq.vi: ‘Hôm qua trời có mưa không?’ ‘Không, trời đẹp.’
mcq.expl:
Positive, negative or question depends on the meaning.
Khẳng định, phủ định hay câu hỏi tùy theo nghĩa.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Câu hỏi → Did it rain?
mcq.key: ‘___ yesterday?’ ‘No, it was a nice day.’|Did it rain

Positive, negative or question depends on the meaning.
Khẳng định, phủ định hay câu hỏi tùy theo nghĩa.
Điểm ngữ pháp: didn’t + know.
mcq.key: ‘Why weren’t you at the meeting yesterday?’ ‘I ___ about it.’|didn’t know
